description:
Bandit (Burt Reynolds) finally enters Texas, but Sheriff Buford T. Justice (Jackie Gleason) awaits his arrival with an army of Mountie's. Cledus (Jerry Reed) comes to the rescue with an even more formidable army.

The notorious Bandit and his beautiful companion, Carrie, find themselves involved in a mission of epic proportions: transporting a pregnant elephant cross-country in 24 hours or less! Hot on their heels is archenemy Sheriff Buford T. Justice, who vows to finally put the Bandit behind bars. The duo finds themselves in a race against time, a battle of wits and a test of skills in this non-stop, high-octane comedy hit. © 1980
